title: TAI rolling-update preflight authority
objective: Allow the protected REG.RU activation controller to update an already-materialized, healthy and isolated TAI runtime only when the exact blocker set is expected revision drift, while preserving every bootstrap, strict-pass, security, no-mutation and rollback authority.
boundaries: Full-stack rolling-update eligibility requires exactly API_WEB_NOT_EXACT_MAIN and TAI_RUNTIME_NOT_EXACT_MAIN
Post-full-stack rolling-update eligibility requires exactly TAI_RUNTIME_NOT_EXACT_MAIN and API_WEB_EXACT_MAIN PASS

Rolling-update eligibility additionally requires TAI_SERVICE_DECLARED, TAI_RUNTIME_HEALTHY, TAI_RUNTIME_ISOLATED, TAI_DEDICATED_ENV_MATERIALIZED, TAI_DEDICATED_DB_PRINCIPAL_ATTESTED and TAI_READINESS_READY
Initial four-blocker bootstrap and post-full-stack three-blocker bootstrap classifications remain unchanged
Any additional blocker, unhealthy baseline, missing rollback authority, capacity failure, model-connectivity failure, malformed evidence or detected mutation fails closed
The provider timeout, semantic acceptance, HMAC boundary, private model endpoint, non-root runner, no-Docker runner and restricted root-controller authority are unchanged
The protected activation workflow remains the only production mutation authority and must finish with hosted acceptance plus strict zero-blocker postflight or rollback
No production mutation, credential, database change, hosting service or recurring expense is introduced by this scope
